# A. LENTIC SPECIES

```{r}
MJaccard_Lentic <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/01_Lentic/MJacc_lentic.csv", row.names = 1)
```


```{r}
mean_mean_elev <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/01_Lentic/Mdif_mean_mean_elev.csv", row.names = 1)
mean_min_elev <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/01_Lentic/Mdif_mean_min_elev.csv", row.names = 1)
mean_max_elev <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/01_Lentic/Mdif_mean_max_elev.csv", row.names = 1)
mean_range_elev <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/01_Lentic/Mmean_mean_range_elev.csv",row.names = 1)
mean_richness_h <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/01_Lentic/Mmean_mean_richness_h.csv", row.names = 1)
mean_shannon_h <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/01_Lentic/Mmean_mean_shannon_h.csv", row.names = 1)
volume <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/01_Lentic/Mmean_volume.csv", row.names = 1)
Multi_Climate_Range <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/01_Lentic/Mmean_Multi_Climate_Range.csv", row.names = 1)
```


## 1. Convert matrices to long format

```{r}
mat_to_long <- function(mat, name) {
  as.data.frame(as.table(as.matrix(mat))) %>%
    rename(Species1 = Var1, Species2 = Var2, !!name := Freq)
}

df_Jaccard       <- mat_to_long(MJaccard_Lentic, "Jaccard")
df_mean_elev     <- mat_to_long(mean_mean_elev, "mean_elev")
df_min_elev      <- mat_to_long(mean_min_elev, "min_elev")
df_max_elev      <- mat_to_long(mean_max_elev, "max_elev")
df_range_elev    <- mat_to_long(mean_range_elev, "range_elev")
df_richness_h    <- mat_to_long(mean_richness_h, "richness_h")
df_shannon_h     <- mat_to_long(mean_shannon_h, "shannon_h")
df_volume        <- mat_to_long(volume, "volume")
df_climate_range <- mat_to_long(Multi_Climate_Range, "Multi_Climate_Range")
```

## 2. Combine all matrices into a single dataframe

```{r}
df_all <- df_Jaccard %>%
  left_join(df_mean_elev, by = c("Species1", "Species2")) %>%
  left_join(df_min_elev, by = c("Species1", "Species2")) %>%
  left_join(df_max_elev, by = c("Species1", "Species2")) %>%
  left_join(df_range_elev, by = c("Species1", "Species2")) %>%
  left_join(df_richness_h, by = c("Species1", "Species2")) %>%
  left_join(df_shannon_h, by = c("Species1", "Species2")) %>%
  left_join(df_volume, by = c("Species1", "Species2")) %>%
  left_join(df_climate_range, by = c("Species1", "Species2"))

```


## 3. Filter unique and lentic pairs

```{r}
df_all <- df_all %>%
  left_join(species_group %>% rename(Species1 = species, Group1 = group), by = "Species1") %>%
  left_join(species_group %>% rename(Species2 = species, Group2 = group), by = "Species2")

df_all <- df_all %>%
  mutate(PairID = paste(Species1, Species2, sep = "_"))

all_pairs <- df_all$PairID


# Keep only different lentil pairs
df_lentic <- df_all %>%
  filter(Group1 == "Lentic" & Group2 == "Lentic" & Species1 != Species2)

```


```{r}
lentic_pairs <- df_lentic$PairID

# Eliminated pairs
removed_pairs <- setdiff(all_pairs, lentic_pairs)

head(removed_pairs)

```

```{r}
# Remove duplicates (keep only one address per pair)
df_lentic <- df_lentic %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(PairID = paste(sort(c(Species1, Species2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(PairID, .keep_all = TRUE)
```


```{r}
head(df_lentic)
```


```{r}
# Scale all predictor variables
df_lentic <- df_lentic %>%
  mutate(across(c(mean_elev, min_elev, max_elev, range_elev, richness_h, shannon_h, volume, Multi_Climate_Range),
                scale))
head(df_lentic)
```


## 4. Mixed model with random effects by species

```{r}
model_lentic <- lmer(Jaccard ~ mean_elev + min_elev + max_elev + range_elev +
                       richness_h + shannon_h + volume + Multi_Climate_Range +
                       (1 | Species1) + (1 | Species2),
                     data = df_lentic, REML = FALSE)

summary(model_lentic)

```


## 5. Model evaluation with AICc and selection

```{r}
options(na.action = "na.fail")
modelos_lentic <- dredge(model_lentic, rank = "AICc")  # generates all subsets

```

```{r}
# best models (ordered by AICc)
head(modelos_lentic)
```


```{r}
# See importance of each predictor
sw(modelos_lentic)
```
Models with delta AICc < 4 are considered statistically competitive: therefore, instead of choosing a single model, a weighted average of the models with delta AICc < 4 is calculated. 

```{r}
# Average of models with delta AICc < 4
modelo_avg_lentic <- model.avg(modelos_lentic, subset = delta < 4)
summary(modelo_avg_lentic)
```
 


```{r}
# Relative importance of each variable
sw(modelo_avg_lentic)
```

## 6. Plots

### Graph showing the importance of predictors (AICc weights)

This graph shows how important each variable is in explaining Jaccard similarity, based on AICc weights.

```{r}
# Rename predictors
importance_df <- as.data.frame(sw(modelo_avg_lentic)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Predictor") %>%
  rename(Importance = `sw(modelo_avg_lentic)`) %>%
  mutate(Predictor = recode(Predictor,
                            mean_elev = "Mean elevation",
                            min_elev = "Minimum elevation",
                            max_elev = "Maximum elevation",
                            range_elev = "Elevation range",
                            richness_h = "Habitat richness",
                            shannon_h = "Shannon diversity",
                            volume = "Niche volume",
                            Multi_Climate_Range = "Climatic range")) %>%
  arrange(Importance)


# Plot
plot_i <- ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = reorder(Predictor, Importance), y = Importance, fill = Importance)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#a6cee3", high = "#1f78b4") +
  labs(title = "Relative importance of predictors (AICc weight)",
       x = "Predictor",
       y = "AICc weight (importance)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()
  )

plot_i
```

```{r}
#ggsave("04_Figures/Figure_1_lentic_new.png", plot = plot_i, width = 10, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```

### Graph of averaged coefficients with confidence intervals

This graph shows the averaged coefficients for each predictor along with their standard errors. This allows you to see the direction and magnitude of the effect.

```{r}
# Rename predictors in coefs_df
coefs_lentic <- summary(modelo_avg_lentic)$coefmat.full
coefs_df <- as.data.frame(coefs_lentic) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Predictor") %>%
  filter(Predictor != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(Predictor = recode(Predictor,
                            mean_elev = "Mean elevation",
                            min_elev = "Minimum elevation",
                            max_elev = "Maximum elevation",
                            range_elev = "Elevation range",
                            richness_h = "Habitat richness",
                            shannon_h = "Shannon diversity",
                            volume = "Niche volume",
                            Multi_Climate_Range = "Climatic range"))

# Calculate 95% CI
coefs_df <- coefs_df %>%
  mutate(lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
         upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`)

# Plot
plot_ci <- ggplot(coefs_df, aes(x = reorder(Predictor, Estimate), y = Estimate)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#1f78b4") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.2, color = "#1f78b4") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Model-averaged coefficients with 95% CI (ΔAICc < 4)",
       x = "Predictor",
       y = "Estimated coefficient (± 95% CI)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()
  )
plot_ci

```

```{r}
#ggsave("04_Figures/Figure_2_lentic_new.png", plot = plot_ci, width = 10, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```


```{r}
combined_plot <- (plot_i | plot_ci)
print(combined_plot)
ggsave("04_Figures/Figure_2_combined_lentic_new.png", plot = combined_plot, width = 15, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```

# C. ANALYSIS BETWEEN GROUPS (lentic vs. lotic)

```{r}
MJaccard_all <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/03_LenticVSLotic/MJacc_LenticVSLotic.csv", row.names = 1)
```


```{r}
mean_mean_elev <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/03_LenticVSLotic/Mdif_mean_mean_elev.csv", row.names = 1)
mean_min_elev <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/03_LenticVSLotic/Mdif_mean_min_elev.csv", row.names = 1)
mean_max_elev <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/03_LenticVSLotic/Mdif_mean_max_elev.csv", row.names = 1)
mean_range_elev <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/03_LenticVSLotic/Mmean_mean_range_elev.csv", row.names = 1)
mean_richness_h <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/03_LenticVSLotic/Mmean_mean_richness_h.csv",  row.names = 1)
mean_shannon_h <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/03_LenticVSLotic/Mmean_mean_shannon_h.csv", row.names = 1)
volume <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/03_LenticVSLotic/Mmean_volume.csv", row.names = 1)
Multi_Climate_Range <- read.csv("01_DATA/04_Data_Analysis/03_LenticVSLotic/Mmean_Multi_Climate_Range.csv", row.names = 1)

```


## 1. Convert matrices to long format

```{r}
mat_to_long <- function(mat, name) {
  as.data.frame(as.table(as.matrix(mat))) %>%
    rename(Species1 = Var1, Species2 = Var2, !!name := Freq)
}

df_Jaccard       <- mat_to_long(MJaccard_all, "Jaccard")
df_mean_elev     <- mat_to_long(mean_mean_elev, "mean_elev")
df_min_elev      <- mat_to_long(mean_min_elev, "min_elev")
df_max_elev      <- mat_to_long(mean_max_elev, "max_elev")
df_range_elev    <- mat_to_long(mean_range_elev, "range_elev")
df_richness_h    <- mat_to_long(mean_richness_h, "richness_h")
df_shannon_h     <- mat_to_long(mean_shannon_h, "shannon_h")
df_volume        <- mat_to_long(volume, "volume")
df_climate_range <- mat_to_long(Multi_Climate_Range, "Multi_Climate_Range")
```

```{r}
head(df_mean_elev)
```


## 2. Combine all matrices into a single dataframe

```{r}
df_all <- df_Jaccard %>%
  left_join(df_mean_elev, by = c("Species1", "Species2")) %>%
  left_join(df_min_elev, by = c("Species1", "Species2")) %>%
  left_join(df_max_elev, by = c("Species1", "Species2")) %>%
  left_join(df_range_elev, by = c("Species1", "Species2")) %>%
  left_join(df_richness_h, by = c("Species1", "Species2")) %>%
  left_join(df_shannon_h, by = c("Species1", "Species2")) %>%
  left_join(df_volume, by = c("Species1", "Species2")) %>%
  left_join(df_climate_range, by = c("Species1", "Species2"))

```

## 3. Filter intergroup pairs

```{r}
df_all <- df_all %>%
  left_join(species_group %>% rename(Species1 = species, Group1 = group), by = "Species1") %>%
  left_join(species_group %>% rename(Species2 = species, Group2 = group), by = "Species2")

df_all <- df_all %>%
  mutate(PairID = paste(Species1, Species2, sep = "_"))

all_pairs <- df_all$PairID

# Mantener solo pares lénticos diferentes
df_inter  <- df_all %>%
  filter(((Group1 == "Lentic" & Group2 == "Lotic") | (Group1 == "Lotic" & Group2 == "Lentic")) & Species1 != Species2)


```

```{r}
df_inter <- df_inter %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(PairID_sorted = paste(sort(c(Species1, Species2)), collapse = "_")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(PairID_sorted, .keep_all = TRUE)

```

```{r}
head(df_inter)
```

```{r}
df_inter <- df_inter %>%
  mutate(across(c(mean_elev, min_elev, max_elev, range_elev, richness_h, shannon_h, volume, Multi_Climate_Range),
                scale))
head(df_inter)
```


## 4. Mixed model with random effects by species

```{r}
model_inter <- lmer(Jaccard ~ mean_elev + min_elev + max_elev + range_elev +
                       richness_h + shannon_h + volume + Multi_Climate_Range +
                       (1 | Species1) + (1 | Species2),
                     data = df_inter, REML = FALSE)

summary(model_inter)

```

## 5. Model evaluation with AICc and selection

```{r}
options(na.action = "na.fail")
modelos_inter <- dredge(model_inter, rank = "AICc")
```

```{r}
# best models (ordered by AICc) 
head(modelos_inter)
```

```{r}
# See importance of each predictor
sw(modelos_inter)
```

```{r}
# Average of models with delta AICc < 4
modelo_avg_inter <- model.avg(modelos_inter, subset = delta < 4)
summary(modelo_avg_inter)
```


```{r}
# Relative importance of each variable
sw(modelo_avg_inter)
```

## 6. Plots

### Graph showing the importance of predictors (AICc weights)

```{r}
# Rename predictors
importance_df <- as.data.frame(sw(modelo_avg_inter)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Predictor") %>%
  rename(Importance = `sw(modelo_avg_inter)`) %>%
  mutate(Predictor = recode(Predictor,
                            mean_elev = "Mean elevation",
                            min_elev = "Minimum elevation",
                            max_elev = "Maximum elevation",
                            range_elev = "Elevation range",
                            richness_h = "Habitat richness",
                            shannon_h = "Shannon diversity",
                            volume = "Niche volume",
                            Multi_Climate_Range = "Climatic range")) %>%
  arrange(Importance)

# Plot
plot_i <- ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = reorder(Predictor, Importance), y = Importance, fill = Importance)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#fdbf6f", high = "#ff7f00") +
  labs(title = "Relative importance of predictors (AICc weight)",
       x = "Predictor",
       y = "AICc weight (importance)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()
  )

plot_i
```

```{r}
#ggsave("04_Figures/Figure_5_inter_new.png", plot = plot_i, width = 10, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```


### Graph of averaged coefficients with confidence intervals

```{r}
# Rename predictors in coefs_df
coefs_inter <- summary(modelo_avg_inter)$coefmat.full
coefs_df <- as.data.frame(coefs_inter) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Predictor") %>%
  filter(Predictor != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(Predictor = recode(Predictor,
                            mean_elev = "Mean elevation",
                            min_elev = "Minimum elevation",
                            max_elev = "Maximum elevation",
                            range_elev = "Elevation range",
                            richness_h = "Habitat richness",
                            shannon_h = "Shannon diversity",
                            volume = "Niche volume",
                            Multi_Climate_Range = "Climatic range"))

# Calculate 95% CI
coefs_df <- coefs_df %>%
  mutate(lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
         upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`)

# Plot
plot_ci <- ggplot(coefs_df, aes(x = reorder(Predictor, Estimate), y = Estimate)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#ff7f00") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.2, color = "#ff7f00") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Model-averaged coefficients with 95% CI (ΔAICc < 4)",
       x = "Predictor",
       y = "Estimated coefficient (± 95% CI)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()
  )
plot_ci

```

```{r}
#ggsave("04_Figures/Figure_6_inter_new.png", plot = plot_ci, width = 10, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```


```{r}
combined_plot <- (plot_i | plot_ci)
print(combined_plot)
ggsave("04_Figures/Figure_4_combined_inter_new.png", plot = combined_plot, width = 15, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```

```{r}
coefs_lotic$Group <- "Intra-Lotic"
coefs_inter$Group <- "Intergroup"
```

```{r}
  rownames_to_column(var = "Predictor")
```

```{r}
                            max_elev = "Maximum elevation",
```

```{r}

  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +

       x = "Estimated coefficient (± 95% CI)",

  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
```
